articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Cedar Hollow Garden Club
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. Please keep the park bench program in the budget. Many of us on Walnut Road use it every week.

To the editor: I have lived on Walnut Road for 38 years, and I want to say what a difference the Cedar Hollow Garden Club has made. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the February meeting.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Arthur Kim, Marsh Landing
